+name: Verify and package evidence
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+jobs:
+  system:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    services:
+      postgres:
+        image: postgres:16
+        env:
+          POSTGRES_USER: console
+          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci-only-database-password
+          POSTGRES_DB: console_test
+        ports: ['5432:5432']
+        options: >-
+          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U console -d console_test"
+          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
+    env:
+      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://console:ci-only-database-password@127.0.0.1:5432/console_test
+      APP_ORIGIN: http://localhost:3000
+      SANDBOX_URL: http://127.0.0.1:4100
+      ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET: '1'
+      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+          cache: npm
+      - name: Generate ephemeral sandbox credentials
+        run: node scripts/ci-credentials.mjs
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npm run db:generate
+      - run: npm run db:migrate
+      - run: npm run format:check
+      - run: npm run lint
+      - run: npm run typecheck
+      - run: npm run build:runtime
+      - run: npm run test:coverage
+      - run: npm run db:seed
+      - run: npm run build --workspace apps/web
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - run: npm run test:e2e
+      - run: npm run security:secrets
+      - run: npm run security:audit
+      - run: npm run evidence:check
+      - name: Package reviewed source for release preparation
+        run: git archive --format=tar.gz --output=artifacts/reviewed-source.tar.gz HEAD
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: engineering-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: |
+            artifacts/
+            test-results/
+            playwright-report/
+          retention-days: 14
+          if-no-files-found: error
+      - name: Review boundary
+        run: echo "Verification and source packaging only. Production deployment requires owner approval and a configured host."
+  containers:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    env:
+      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
+      E2E_EXTERNAL_SERVICES: '1'
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+          cache: npm
+      - name: Generate and mask ephemeral container credentials
+        run: node scripts/ci-credentials.mjs --containers
+      - run: npm ci
+      - name: Validate Compose configuration without printing secrets
+        run: docker compose --env-file .env.docker config --quiet
+      - name: Build and start isolated local review stack
+        run: docker compose --env-file .env.docker up --build --detach --wait --wait-timeout 180
+      - name: Execute compiled-container integration smoke checks
+        run: node scripts/container-smoke.mjs
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - name: Drive standalone frontend against container API, database and worker
+        run: npm run test:e2e
+      - name: Collect service status and sanitized logs
+        if: always()
+        run: node scripts/collect-container-evidence.mjs
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: container-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: |
+            artifacts/
+            test-results/
+            playwright-report/
+          retention-days: 14
+          if-no-files-found: error
+      - name: Remove only the disposable CI stack
+        if: always()
+        run: docker compose --env-file .env.docker down --volumes

+# Local review/demo images. No image publishing or production deployment is configured.
+FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS base
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssl ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+WORKDIR /app
+
+FROM base AS dependencies
+COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
+COPY apps/api/package.json ./apps/api/package.json
+COPY apps/web/package.json ./apps/web/package.json
+COPY packages/contracts/package.json ./packages/contracts/package.json
+RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
+
+FROM dependencies AS build
+COPY . .
+ARG API_URL=http://api:4000
+ENV API_URL=${API_URL} NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
+RUN npm run db:generate && npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace apps/web
+
+# The disposable migration/seed image includes the Prisma CLI; application images do not.
+FROM build AS tools
+USER node
+CMD ["node", "scripts/bootstrap-container.mjs"]
+
+FROM build AS production-dependencies
+RUN npm prune --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
+
+FROM base AS runtime
+COPY --from=production-dependencies --chown=node:node /app/node_modules ./node_modules
+COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist ./dist
+COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/package.json ./package.json
+USER node
+CMD ["node", "dist/apps/api/src/server.js"]
+
+FROM base AS web
+ENV NODE_ENV=production NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 PORT=3000 HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0
+COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/apps/web/.next/standalone ./
+COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/apps/web/.next/static ./apps/web/.next/static
+USER node
+EXPOSE 3000
+CMD ["node", "apps/web/server.js"]

-# fullstack-ai-operations-console
-Full-stack AI operations console built with Next.js, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. Focused on workflow execution, API integrations, human approvals, and operational visibility.
+# Full-Stack AI Operations Console
+
+An operations workspace for defining workflows, approving requests, executing an HTTP integration, and investigating failures. Next.js/React/TypeScript provide the interface; Fastify exposes the API; Prisma persists records in PostgreSQL; a separate worker owns execution.
+
+The integration is an explicit **deterministic sandbox** for support-request classification and synthetic ticket creation. There is no live LLM, customer data, or claimed business ROI. This project demonstrates the application and operational controls around a provider boundary.
+
+## Review
+
+[Evidence index](docs/EVIDENCE.md) · [Case study](docs/PORTFOLIO_CASE_STUDY.md) · [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [API](docs/API.md) · [Decisions](docs/DECISIONS.md) · [Container setup and release boundary](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) · [Limitations](docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)
+
+## Behavior
+
+- Persisted cookie sessions, revocation/expiry, operator/viewer permissions, and owner-scoped records.
+- Workflow CRUD with optimistic versions and archival that retains history.
+- Validated execution input, owner-scoped idempotency keys, and immutable workflow snapshots.
+- Approval or rejection before outbound HTTP. Rejected runs cannot execute.
+- A standalone worker with conditional claims, expiring leases, fenced writes, bounded retries/timeouts, and manual recovery.
+- Dashboard, execution history, approval decisions, and attempt/event timelines on desktop and mobile.
+
+## PostgreSQL setup
+
+Requires Node.js 22+, npm, and PostgreSQL 16+. Create a dedicated non-production database and account. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`; configure `DATABASE_URL`, a random `SANDBOX_TOKEN` of at least 24 characters, and a unique `DEMO_PASSWORD` of at least 12 characters. Keep the file private and untracked.
+
+```bash
+npm ci
+npm run db:generate
+npm run db:migrate
+npm run db:seed
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:3000`. The synthetic local accounts are `operator@example.test` and `viewer@example.test`, using your configured password. The viewer begins with no records. Default loopback ports: API 4000, sandbox 4100, worker health 4200.
+
+For the built frontend:
+
+```bash
+npm run build
+npm run start --workspace apps/web
+```
+
+Run the API, worker, and sandbox separately using their scripts. `APP_ORIGIN` must exactly match the browser origin. Production mode requires HTTPS and uses Secure cookies. `API_URL` configures the Next.js upstream rewrite **at build time**. A production host/provider is outside this sandbox release.
+
+## Restricted-container fallback
+
+PGlite runs the real PostgreSQL WASM engine through a development TCP multiplexer. It differs from native PostgreSQL concurrency and has no socket authentication, so it binds only to loopback. CI uses native PostgreSQL.
+
+```bash
+npm run setup:local
+node scripts/verify-local.mjs dev
+```
+
+The setup command creates ignored `.env` and `.env.test` with random credentials and separate local database ports. Read `DEMO_PASSWORD` privately from `.env`. It refuses to overwrite existing environments. The harness keeps services and checks in one parent network namespace.
+
+## Docker review stack
+
+Requires Docker Engine and Compose v2. This is a loopback-only local demonstration with a built standalone Next.js frontend, compiled Node.js API/worker/sandbox, native PostgreSQL, migrations and synthetic demo accounts.
+
+```bash
+node scripts/setup-containers.mjs
+docker compose --env-file .env.docker up --build --detach --wait --wait-timeout 180
+node --env-file=.env.docker scripts/container-smoke.mjs
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:3000`. Read the password privately from ignored `.env.docker`. Only the frontend port is published, on `127.0.0.1`. Stop the demo with `docker compose --env-file .env.docker down`; this preserves its database volume. Details, browser reproduction and production prerequisites are in [DEPLOYMENT.md](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).
+
+## Checks
+
+Integration tests **truncate the configured test database**. Use a disposable database and set `ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET=1`. Never point tests at production. `.env.test` is loaded for unit/integration checks.
+
+```bash
+npm run typecheck
+npm run lint
+npm run format:check
+npm run test:coverage
+npm run build:runtime
+npm run build --workspace apps/web
+npm run db:seed
+npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+npm run test:e2e
+npm run security:secrets
+npm run security:audit
+npm run evidence:check
+```
+
+For the restricted container:
+
+```bash
+node scripts/verify-local.mjs tests
+node scripts/prepare-browser.mjs
+node scripts/verify-local.mjs e2e
+```
+
+The fallback browser is real Chromium from `@sparticuz/chromium`, with installed FFmpeg for recording. E2E starts the built frontend, API, database connection, worker, and sandbox. It drives the UI without mocking API responses.
+
+The local PGlite harness marks one database constraint-error case as native-only because its bridge does not reliably relay that error protocol to Prisma. That case is explicitly skipped locally and executed in the native PostgreSQL CI suite; this distinction is reported in the evidence counts.
+
+GitHub Actions checks formatting, ESLint, strict types, native PostgreSQL integration, compiled backend and standalone frontend builds, desktop/mobile E2E, known secret patterns, and npm advisories. A separate container job builds and runs the Compose stack, executes HTTP smoke checks and runs the same browser suite against those containers. Generated CI credentials are masked before entering later step environments. Recordings/traces/reports have 14-day retention; reviewed source is packaged for approval. No workflow merges or deploys production.
+
+## Layout
+
+| Path                         | Purpose                                                   |
+| ---------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------- |
+| `apps/web`                   | Next.js UI and same-origin rewrite                        |
+| `apps/api/src`               | Fastify, authentication, engine, worker, HTTP sandbox     |
+| `packages/contracts`         | Zod contracts and TypeScript UI types                     |
+| `prisma`                     | Schema, versioned SQL migrations, local seed              |
+| `tests`                      | Unit, database/API/integration, browser E2E               |
+| `scripts`                    | Verification, audits, local fallback                      |
+| `Dockerfile`, `compose.yaml` | Isolated local review stack and build targets             |
+| `docs`                       | Evidence, architecture, limitations, selected screenshots |
+| `.github/workflows`          | Verification and review artifact packaging                |
+
+Current executed results are listed in the evidence index. A test's presence alone is not evidence that it passed.

+import Fastify, { FastifyRequest } from 'fastify';
+import cookie from '@fastify/cookie';
+import helmet from '@fastify/helmet';
+import rateLimit from '@fastify/rate-limit';
+import { PrismaClient, User } from '@prisma/client';
+import { z, ZodError } from 'zod';
+import {
+  workflowSchema,
+  loginSchema,
+  decisionSchema,
+  idSchema,
+  idempotencySchema,
+  runStatuses,
+} from '../../../packages/contracts/src/index.js';
+import { getConfig } from './config.js';
+import { digest, hashPassword, safeEqual, token, verifyPassword } from './auth.js';
+import { AppError, notFound } from './errors.js';
+import { admitRun, decideRun, recoverRun } from './engine.js';
+
+declare module 'fastify' {
+  interface FastifyRequest {
+    principal?: User;
+    csrfToken?: string;
+    sessionId?: string;
+  }
+}
+export async function buildApp(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  options: { logging?: boolean; rateLimit?: boolean } = {},
+) {
+  const config = getConfig();
+  const app = Fastify({
+    bodyLimit: 16384,
+    requestTimeout: 15000,
+    logger: options.logging
+      ? {
+          redact: [
+            'req.headers.cookie',
+            'req.headers.authorization',
+            'req.body',
+            'res.headers.set-cookie',
+          ],
+          level: 'info',
+        }
+      : false,
+  });
+  await app.register(cookie);
+  await app.register(helmet);
+  if (options.rateLimit !== false)
+    await app.register(rateLimit, { max: 600, timeWindow: '1 minute' });
+  const dummyHash = await hashPassword(token());
+  const user = (r: FastifyRequest) => {
+    if (!r.principal) throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Sign in required');
+    return r.principal;
+  };
+  const operator = (r: FastifyRequest) => {
+    const u = user(r);
+    if (u.role !== 'OPERATOR') throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Operator permission required');
+    return u;
+  };
+  app.addHook('onRequest', async (req, reply) => {
+    reply.header('cache-control', 'no-store');
+    const path = req.url.split('?')[0];
+    if (path === '/health' || path === '/v1/auth/login') return;
+    const raw = req.cookies.ops_session;
+    if (!raw || raw.length !== 64) throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Sign in required');
+    const session = await db.session.findUnique({
+      where: { id: digest(raw) },
+      include: { user: true },
+    });
+    if (!session || session.expiresAt <= new Date())
+      throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Session expired or invalid');
+    req.principal = session.user;
+    req.csrfToken = session.csrfToken;
+    req.sessionId = session.id;
+    if (['POST', 'PATCH', 'PUT', 'DELETE'].includes(req.method)) {
+      if (req.headers.origin !== config.APP_ORIGIN)
+        throw new AppError(403, 'INVALID_ORIGIN', 'Request origin is not allowed');
+      const csrf = req.headers['x-csrf-token'];
+      if (typeof csrf !== 'string' || !safeEqual(csrf, session.csrfToken))
+        throw new AppError(403, 'INVALID_CSRF', 'CSRF token is missing or invalid');
+    }
+  });
+  app.setErrorHandler((error, req, reply) => {
+    if (error instanceof ZodError)
+      return reply.code(400).send({
+        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
+        message: 'Request validation failed',
+        fields: error.issues.map((i) => ({ path: i.path.join('.'), message: i.message })),
+        requestId: req.id,
+      });
+    if (error instanceof AppError)
+      return reply
+        .code(error.statusCode)
+        .send({ code: error.code, message: error.message, requestId: req.id });
+    const status = (error as { statusCode?: number }).statusCode;
+    if (status && status < 500)
+      return reply.code(status).send({
+        code: status === 429 ? 'RATE_LIMITED' : 'BAD_REQUEST',
+        message: status === 429 ? 'Too many requests' : 'Request could not be processed',
+        requestId: req.id,
+      });
+    req.log.error({ err: error, requestId: req.id }, 'request_failed');
+    return reply
+      .code(500)
+      .send({ code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'Request failed', requestId: req.id });
+  });
+  app.get('/health', async () => {
+    await db.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
+    return { status: 'ok', database: 'connected' };
+  });
+  app.post(
+    '/v1/auth/login',
+    { config: { rateLimit: { max: 8, timeWindow: '1 minute' } } },
+    async (req, reply) => {
+      if (req.headers.origin !== config.APP_ORIGIN)
+        throw new AppError(403, 'INVALID_ORIGIN', 'Request origin is not allowed');
+      const data = loginSchema.parse(req.body);
+      const found = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
+      const valid = await verifyPassword(data.password, found?.passwordHash ?? dummyHash);
+      if (!found || !valid)
+        throw new AppError(401, 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'Email or password is incorrect');
+      const raw = token(),
+        csrfToken = token(),
+        expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
+      await db.session.create({
+        data: { id: digest(raw), userId: found.id, csrfToken, expiresAt },
+      });
+      reply.setCookie('ops_session', raw, {
+        httpOnly: true,
+        secure: config.NODE_ENV === 'production',
+        sameSite: 'strict',
+        path: '/',
+        maxAge: 8 * 60 * 60,
+      });
+      return { user: { id: found.id, email: found.email, role: found.role }, csrfToken };
+    },
+  );
+  app.get('/v1/auth/me', async (req) => {
+    const u = user(req);
+    return { user: { id: u.id, email: u.email, role: u.role }, csrfToken: req.csrfToken };
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/auth/logout', async (req, reply) => {
+    await db.session.deleteMany({ where: { id: req.sessionId } });
+    reply.clearCookie('ops_session', { path: '/' });
+    return { ok: true };
+  });
+  app.get('/v1/workflows', async (req) => ({
+    items: await db.workflow.findMany({
+      where: { ownerId: user(req).id, archived: false },
+      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
+      take: 100,
+    }),
+  }));
+  app.post('/v1/workflows', async (req, reply) => {
+    const data = workflowSchema.parse(req.body);
+    reply.code(201);
+    return db.workflow.create({ data: { ...data, ownerId: operator(req).id } });
+  });
+  app.patch('/v1/workflows/:id', async (req) => {
+    const id = idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id),
+      ownerId = operator(req).id;
+    const { version, ...data } = workflowSchema
+      .extend({ version: z.number().int().positive() })
+      .parse(req.body);
+    const result = await db.workflow.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, version, archived: false },
+      data: { ...data, version: { increment: 1 } },
+    });
+    if (!result.count) {
+      const found = await db.workflow.findFirst({ where: { id, ownerId, archived: false } });
+      if (!found) throw notFound();
+      throw new AppError(409, 'VERSION_CONFLICT', 'Workflow changed; reload before saving');
+    }
+    return db.workflow.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+  });
+  app.delete('/v1/workflows/:id', async (req) => {
+    const id = idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id),
+      ownerId = operator(req).id;
+    const result = await db.workflow.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, archived: false },
+      data: { archived: true },
+    });
+    if (!result.count) throw notFound();
+    return { ok: true };
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/workflows/:id/runs', async (req, reply) => {
+    const ownerId = operator(req).id,
+      id = idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id),
+      key = idempotencySchema.parse(req.headers['idempotency-key']);
+    const result = await admitRun(db, ownerId, id, key, req.body);
+    reply.code(result.replayed ? 200 : 201);
+    return result;
+  });
+  app.get('/v1/runs', async (req) => {
+    const query = z
+      .object({
+        status: z.enum(runStatuses).optional(),
+        cursor: z.uuid().optional(),
+        limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(30),
+      })
+      .strict()
+      .parse(req.query);
+    const items = await db.run.findMany({
+      where: { ownerId: user(req).id, ...(query.status ? { status: query.status } : {}) },
+      orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
+      take: query.limit + 1,
+      ...(query.cursor ? { cursor: { id: query.cursor }, skip: 1 } : {}),
+    });
+    const more = items.length > query.limit;
+    if (more) items.pop();
+    return { items, nextCursor: more ? items.at(-1)?.id : null };
+  });
+  app.get('/v1/runs/:id', async (req) => {
+    const run = await db.run.findFirst({
+      where: { id: idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id), ownerId: user(req).id },
+      include: {
+        attempts: { orderBy: { number: 'asc' } },
+        events: { orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }] },
+      },
+    });
+    if (!run) throw notFound();
+    return run;
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/runs/:id/decision', async (req) => {
+    const ownerId = operator(req).id;
+    const { decision } = decisionSchema.parse(req.body);
+    return decideRun(db, ownerId, idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id), decision);
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/runs/:id/retry', async (req) =>
+    recoverRun(db, operator(req).id, idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id)),
+  );
+  app.get('/v1/dashboard', async (req) => {
+    const ownerId = user(req).id;
+    const [grouped, workflowCount, recent] = await Promise.all([
+      db.run.groupBy({ by: ['status'], where: { ownerId }, _count: { _all: true } }),
+      db.workflow.count({ where: { ownerId, archived: false } }),
+      db.run.findMany({ where: { ownerId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 6 }),
+    ]);
+    const counts = Object.fromEntries(
+      runStatuses.map((s) => [s, grouped.find((g) => g.status === s)?._count._all ?? 0]),
+    );
+    return { workflowCount, counts, recent };
+  });
+  return app;
+}

+import { createHash, randomBytes, scrypt as scryptCallback, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
+import { promisify } from 'node:util';
+const scrypt = promisify(scryptCallback);
+export async function hashPassword(password: string) {
+  const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
+  const hash = (await scrypt(password, salt, 64)) as Buffer;
+  return `scrypt:${salt}:${hash.toString('hex')}`;
+}
+export async function verifyPassword(password: string, encoded: string) {
+  const [scheme, salt, value] = encoded.split(':');
+  if (scheme !== 'scrypt' || !salt || !value || value.length !== 128) return false;
+  const candidate = (await scrypt(password, salt, 64)) as Buffer;
+  const expected = Buffer.from(value, 'hex');
+  return candidate.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(candidate, expected);
+}
+export const digest = (value: string) => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
+export const token = () => randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
+export function safeEqual(a: string, b: string) {
+  const x = Buffer.from(a),
+    y = Buffer.from(b);
+  return x.length === y.length && timingSafeEqual(x, y);
+}

+import { z } from 'zod';
+export function getConfig() {
+  const c = z
+    .object({
+      DATABASE_URL: z.string().startsWith('postgresql://'),
+      APP_ORIGIN: z.url().default('http://localhost:3000'),
+      SANDBOX_URL: z.url().default('http://127.0.0.1:4100'),
+      SANDBOX_TOKEN: z.string().min(24),
+      NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development'),
+    })
+    .parse(process.env);
+  const origin = new URL(c.APP_ORIGIN);
+  if (c.APP_ORIGIN !== origin.origin)
+    throw new Error('APP_ORIGIN must be an origin without a path');
+  if (c.NODE_ENV === 'production' && origin.protocol !== 'https:')
+    throw new Error('Production requires HTTPS APP_ORIGIN');
+  const sandbox = new URL(c.SANDBOX_URL);
+  if (
+    !['http:', 'https:'].includes(sandbox.protocol) ||
+    sandbox.username ||
+    sandbox.password ||
+    sandbox.search ||
+    sandbox.hash
+  )
+    throw new Error('Invalid configured integration URL');
+  return c;
+}

+++ b/apps/api/src/engine.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,360 @@
+import { Prisma, PrismaClient, Run } from '@prisma/client';
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
+import {
+  workflowSchema,
+  executionSchema,
+  sandboxResultSchema,
+} from '../../../packages/contracts/src/index.js';
+import { AppError, notFound } from './errors.js';
+import { digest } from './auth.js';
+
+const json = (v: unknown) => v as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
+export const snapshot = (run: Run) => {
+  const { version, ...data } = run.workflowSnapshot as Record<string, unknown>;
+  return workflowSchema.parse(data);
+};
+export async function admitRun(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  ownerId: string,
+  workflowId: string,
+  key: string,
+  payload: unknown,
+) {
+  const input = executionSchema.parse(payload);
+  const requestHash = digest(JSON.stringify({ workflowId, input }));
+  const existing = await db.run.findUnique({
+    where: { ownerId_idempotencyKey: { ownerId, idempotencyKey: key } },
+  });
+  if (existing) {
+    if (existing.requestHash !== requestHash)
+      throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', 'This key was used for different input');
+    return { run: existing, replayed: true };
+  }
+  const workflow = await db.workflow.findFirst({
+    where: { id: workflowId, ownerId, archived: false },
+  });
+  if (!workflow) throw notFound();
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const id = randomUUID();
+    const created = await tx.run.createMany({
+      skipDuplicates: true,
+      data: {
+        id,
+        ownerId,
+        workflowId,
+        idempotencyKey: key,
+        requestHash,
+        input: json(input),
+        workflowSnapshot: json({
+          ...workflowSchema.parse({
+            name: workflow.name,
+            description: workflow.description,
+            requiresApproval: workflow.requiresApproval,
+            maxAttempts: workflow.maxAttempts,
+            timeoutMs: workflow.timeoutMs,
+            sandboxMode: workflow.sandboxMode,
+          }),
+          version: workflow.version,
+        }),
+        status: workflow.requiresApproval ? 'WAITING_APPROVAL' : 'QUEUED',
+      },
+    });
+    const run = await tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({
+      where: { ownerId_idempotencyKey: { ownerId, idempotencyKey: key } },
+    });
+    if (run.requestHash !== requestHash)
+      throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', 'This key was used for different input');
+    if (created.count)
+      await tx.runEvent.create({
+        data: {
+          runId: id,
+          type: workflow.requiresApproval ? 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' : 'RUN_ADMITTED',
+          actorId: ownerId,
+          detail: { workflowVersion: workflow.version },
+        },
+      });
+    return { run, replayed: created.count === 0 };
+  });
+}
+export async function decideRun(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  ownerId: string,
+  id: string,
+  decision: 'approve' | 'reject',
+) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const run = await tx.run.findFirst({ where: { id, ownerId } });
+    if (!run) throw notFound();
+    const changed = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, status: 'WAITING_APPROVAL' },
+      data: {
+        status: decision === 'approve' ? 'QUEUED' : 'REJECTED',
+        approvedBy: ownerId,
+        decidedAt: new Date(),
+        completedAt: decision === 'reject' ? new Date() : null,
+      },
+    });
+    if (!changed.count)
+      throw new AppError(409, 'STATE_CONFLICT', 'Approval has already been decided');
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: {
+        runId: id,
+        actorId: ownerId,
+        type: decision === 'approve' ? 'APPROVED' : 'REJECTED',
+        detail: {},
+      },
+    });
+    return tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+  });
+}
+export async function recoverRun(db: PrismaClient, ownerId: string, id: string) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const run = await tx.run.findFirst({ where: { id, ownerId } });
+    if (!run) throw notFound();
+    const changed = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, status: 'FAILED', recoveryCount: { lt: 3 } },
+      data: {
+        status: 'QUEUED',
+        cycleAttempts: 0,
+        recoveryCount: { increment: 1 },
+        errorCode: null,
+        errorMessage: null,
+        completedAt: null,
+        availableAt: new Date(),
+      },
+    });
+    if (!changed.count)
+      throw new AppError(
+        409,
+        'STATE_CONFLICT',
+        'Only failed runs with fewer than 3 recoveries can be retried',
+      );
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: {
+        runId: id,
+        actorId: ownerId,
+        type: 'RECOVERY_REQUESTED',
+        detail: { recovery: run.recoveryCount + 1 },
+      },
+    });
+    return tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+  });
+}
+export async function claimRun(db: PrismaClient, now = new Date()) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const run = await tx.run.findFirst({
+      where: { status: 'QUEUED', availableAt: { lte: now } },
+      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
+    });
+    if (!run) return null;
+    const config = snapshot(run),
+      leaseToken = randomUUID();
+    const result = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id: run.id, status: 'QUEUED' },
+      data: {
+        status: 'RUNNING',
+        attemptCount: { increment: 1 },
+        cycleAttempts: { increment: 1 },
+        leaseToken,
+        leaseUntil: new Date(now.getTime() + config.timeoutMs + 5000),
+      },
+    });
+    if (!result.count) return null;
+    await tx.attempt.create({ data: { runId: run.id, number: run.attemptCount + 1 } });
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: { runId: run.id, type: 'ATTEMPT_STARTED', detail: { attempt: run.attemptCount + 1 } },
+    });
+    return tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: run.id } });
+  });
+}
+export type Outcome =
+  | { ok: true; output: Prisma.InputJsonValue }
+  | { ok: false; code: string; message: string; retryable: boolean };
+export async function settleRun(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  run: Run,
+  outcome: Outcome,
+  now = new Date(),
+  retryDelayMs = 250,
+) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const config = snapshot(run);
+    const retry = !outcome.ok && outcome.retryable && run.cycleAttempts < config.maxAttempts;
+    const status = outcome.ok ? 'SUCCEEDED' : retry ? 'QUEUED' : 'FAILED';
+    const changed = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id: run.id, status: 'RUNNING', leaseToken: run.leaseToken, leaseUntil: { gt: now } },
+      data: {
+        status,
+        leaseToken: null,
+        leaseUntil: null,
+        ...(outcome.ok
+          ? { output: outcome.output, errorCode: null, errorMessage: null }
+          : { errorCode: outcome.code, errorMessage: outcome.message }),
+        availableAt: new Date(
+          now.getTime() + retryDelayMs * Math.pow(2, Math.max(0, run.cycleAttempts - 1)),
+        ),
+        completedAt: status === 'QUEUED' ? null : now,
+      },
+    });
+    if (!changed.count) return false; // Lease fencing: expired/stale workers cannot commit.
+    await tx.attempt.update({
+      where: { runId_number: { runId: run.id, number: run.attemptCount } },
+      data: {
+        status: outcome.ok ? 'SUCCEEDED' : outcome.code === 'TIMEOUT' ? 'TIMED_OUT' : 'FAILED',
+        errorCode: outcome.ok ? null : outcome.code,
+        finishedAt: now,
+      },
+    });
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: {
+        runId: run.id,
+        type: outcome.ok ? 'RUN_SUCCEEDED' : retry ? 'RETRY_SCHEDULED' : 'RUN_FAILED',
+        detail: outcome.ok
+          ? { attempt: run.attemptCount }
+          : { attempt: run.attemptCount, code: outcome.code },
+      },
+    });
+    return true;
+  });
+}
+export async function reapExpired(db: PrismaClient, now = new Date()) {
+  const expired = await db.run.findMany({
+    where: { status: 'RUNNING', leaseUntil: { lte: now } },
+    take: 50,
+  });
+  let recovered = 0;
+  for (const run of expired) {
+    const done = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const exhausted = run.cycleAttempts >= snapshot(run).maxAttempts;
+      const result = await tx.run.updateMany({
+        where: {
+          id: run.id,
+          status: 'RUNNING',
+          leaseToken: run.leaseToken,
+          leaseUntil: { lte: now },
+        },
+        data: {
+          status: exhausted ? 'FAILED' : 'QUEUED',
+          leaseToken: null,
+          leaseUntil: null,
+          availableAt: now,
+          errorCode: 'WORKER_LOST',
+          errorMessage: 'Worker lease expired; execution ownership was recovered',
+          completedAt: exhausted ? now : null,
+        },
+      });
+      if (!result.count) return 0;
+      await tx.attempt.update({
+        where: { runId_number: { runId: run.id, number: run.attemptCount } },
+        data: { status: 'WORKER_LOST', errorCode: 'WORKER_LOST', finishedAt: now },
+      });
+      await tx.runEvent.create({
+        data: {
+          runId: run.id,
+          type: 'LEASE_EXPIRED',
+          detail: { attempt: run.attemptCount, exhausted },
+        },
+      });
+      return 1;
+    });
+    recovered += done;
+  }
+  return recovered;
+}
+export async function executeSandbox(
+  run: Run,
+  url: string,
+  integrationToken: string,
+): Promise<Outcome> {
+  const config = snapshot(run);
+  const controller = new AbortController();
+  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), config.timeoutMs);
+  try {
+    // The integration URL is server-configured. Workflow input cannot select arbitrary hosts.
+    const response = await fetch(`${url.replace(/\/$/, '')}/tickets`, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      redirect: 'error',
+      signal: controller.signal,
+      headers: {
+        'content-type': 'application/json',
+        authorization: `Bearer ${integrationToken}`,
+        'idempotency-key': run.id,
+        'x-attempt': String(run.attemptCount),
+      },
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        input: run.input,
+        mode: config.sandboxMode,
+        maxAttempts: config.maxAttempts,
+      }),
+    });
+    if (!response.ok)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: response.status >= 500 ? 'UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE' : 'UPSTREAM_REJECTED',
+        message: `Sandbox returned HTTP ${response.status}`,
+        retryable: response.status >= 500 || response.status === 429,
+      };
+    // Bound the body before JSON parsing, including chunked responses.
+    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
+    if (!reader) throw new Error('Empty body');
+    let size = 0;
+    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
+    while (true) {
+      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
+      if (done) break;
+      size += value.length;
+      if (size > 16384) {
+        await reader.cancel();
+        return {
+          ok: false,
+          code: 'INVALID_RESPONSE',
+          message: 'Sandbox response exceeded 16 KiB',
+          retryable: false,
+        };
+      }
+      chunks.push(value);
+    }
+    const result = sandboxResultSchema.safeParse(
+      JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')),
+    );
+    if (!result.success)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: 'INVALID_RESPONSE',
+        message: 'Sandbox returned an invalid response',
+        retryable: false,
+      };
+    return { ok: true, output: json(result.data) };
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (controller.signal.aborted)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: 'TIMEOUT',
+        message: `Sandbox exceeded ${config.timeoutMs} ms timeout`,
+        retryable: true,
+      };
+    if (error instanceof SyntaxError)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: 'INVALID_RESPONSE',
+        message: 'Sandbox returned invalid JSON',
+        retryable: false,
+      };
+    return {
+      ok: false,
+      code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',
+      message: 'Sandbox connection failed',
+      retryable: true,
+    };
+  } finally {
+    clearTimeout(timer);
+  }
+}
+export async function workerTick(db: PrismaClient, url: string, integrationToken: string) {
+  await reapExpired(db);
+  const run = await claimRun(db);
+  if (!run) return null;
+  const result = await executeSandbox(run, url, integrationToken);
+  await settleRun(db, run, result);
+  return run.id;
+}

+import Fastify from 'fastify';
+import { z } from 'zod';
+import { digest, safeEqual } from './auth.js';
+import { executionSchema, workflowSchema } from '../../../packages/contracts/src/index.js';
+export function classify(message: string) {
+  const m = message.toLowerCase();
+  return {
+    category: /bill|invoice|payment|refund/.test(m)
+      ? ('billing' as const)
+      : /error|broken|api|integration/.test(m)
+        ? ('technical' as const)
+        : ('general' as const),
+    priority: /urgent|outage|blocked/.test(m) ? ('urgent' as const) : ('normal' as const),
+    summary: message.trim().slice(0, 160),
+    provider: 'deterministic-sandbox' as const,
+  };
+}
+export async function buildSandbox(integrationToken: string) {
+  const app = Fastify({ bodyLimit: 8192, logger: false });
+  const cache = new Map<string, { hash: string; result: unknown }>();
+  const pending = new Map<string, { hash: string; promise: Promise<unknown> }>(),
+    requestCounts = new Map<string, number>(),
+    creationCounts = new Map<string, number>();
+  let requests = 0;
+  app.get('/health', async () => ({ status: 'ok', provider: 'deterministic-sandbox' }));
+  app.post('/tickets', async (req, reply) => {
+    if (!safeEqual(String(req.headers.authorization ?? ''), `Bearer ${integrationToken}`))
+      return reply.code(401).send({ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' });
+    const schema = z
+      .object({
+        input: executionSchema,
+        mode: workflowSchema.shape.sandboxMode,
+        maxAttempts: z.number().int().min(1).max(5),
+      })
+      .strict();
+    const data = schema.safeParse(req.body);
+    const key = z.uuid().safeParse(req.headers['idempotency-key']);
+    const attempt = z.coerce.number().int().min(1).safeParse(req.headers['x-attempt']);
+    if (!data.success || !key.success || !attempt.success)
+      return reply.code(400).send({ code: 'INVALID_INPUT' });
+    requests++;
+    requestCounts.set(key.data, (requestCounts.get(key.data) ?? 0) + 1);
+    const hash = digest(JSON.stringify(data.data.input)),
+      previous = cache.get(key.data);
+    if (previous) {
+      if (previous.hash !== hash) return reply.code(409).send({ code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' });
+      return previous.result;
+    }
+    const inFlight = pending.get(key.data);
+    if (inFlight) {
+      if (inFlight.hash !== hash) return reply.code(409).send({ code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' });
+      return inFlight.promise;
+    }
+    const { mode, maxAttempts, input } = data.data;
+    if (mode === 'failure') return reply.code(422).send({ code: 'REJECTED' });
+    if (
+      (mode === 'flaky' && attempt.data === 1) ||
+      (mode === 'recoverable' && attempt.data <= maxAttempts)
+    )
+      return reply.code(503).send({ code: 'TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE' });
+    const promise = (async () => {
+      if (mode === 'timeout') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 12000));
+      if (mode === 'slow') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
+      const result = { ticketId: `sbx_${key.data.slice(0, 12)}`, ...classify(input.message) };
+      cache.set(key.data, { hash, result });
+      creationCounts.set(key.data, (creationCounts.get(key.data) ?? 0) + 1);
+      return result;
+    })();
+    pending.set(key.data, { hash, promise });
+    try {
+      return await promise;
+    } finally {
+      pending.delete(key.data);
+    }
+  });
+  return {
+    app,
+    stats: (id?: string) => ({
+      requests: id ? (requestCounts.get(id) ?? 0) : requests,
+      tickets: id ? (creationCounts.get(id) ?? 0) : cache.size,
+    }),
+  };
+}

+import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
+import { getConfig } from './config.js';
+import { workerTick } from './engine.js';
+import { createServer } from 'node:http';
+const config = getConfig(),
+  db = new PrismaClient();
+let stopping = false;
+await db.$connect();
+let healthy = true;
+const health = createServer((req, res) => {
+  res.writeHead(req.url === '/health' ? (healthy ? 200 : 503) : 404, {

+name: Verify and package evidence
+on:
+  push:
+    branches: [main]
+  pull_request:
+  workflow_dispatch:
+permissions:
+  contents: read
+concurrency:
+  group: verify-${{ github.ref }}
+  cancel-in-progress: true
+jobs:
+  system:
+    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+    timeout-minutes: 20
+    services:
+      postgres:
+        image: postgres:16
+        env:
+          POSTGRES_USER: console
+          POSTGRES_PASSWORD: ci-only-database-password
+          POSTGRES_DB: console_test
+        ports: ['5432:5432']
+        options: >-
+          --health-cmd "pg_isready -U console -d console_test"
+          --health-interval 5s --health-timeout 5s --health-retries 10
+    env:
+      DATABASE_URL: postgresql://console:ci-only-database-password@127.0.0.1:5432/console_test
+      APP_ORIGIN: http://localhost:3000
+      SANDBOX_URL: http://127.0.0.1:4100
+      ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET: '1'
+      NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED: '1'
+    steps:
+      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
+      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
+        with:
+          node-version: '22'
+          cache: npm
+      - name: Generate ephemeral sandbox credentials
+        run: node scripts/ci-credentials.mjs
+      - run: npm ci
+      - run: npm run db:generate
+      - run: npm run db:migrate
+      - run: npm run format:check
+      - run: npm run lint
+      - run: npm run typecheck
+      - run: npm run build:runtime
+      - run: npm run test:coverage
+      - run: npm run db:seed
+      - run: npm run build --workspace apps/web
+      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+      - run: npm run test:e2e
+      - run: npm run security:secrets
+      - run: npm run security:audit
+      - run: npm run evidence:check
+      - name: Package reviewed source for release preparation
+        run: git archive --format=tar.gz --output=artifacts/reviewed-source.tar.gz HEAD
+      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
+        if: always()
+        with:
+          name: engineering-evidence-${{ github.sha }}
+          path: |
+            artifacts/
+            test-results/
+            playwright-report/
+          retention-days: 14
+          if-no-files-found: error
+      - name: Review boundary

+  containers:

+# Local review/demo images. No image publishing or production deployment is configured.
+FROM node:22-bookworm-slim AS base
+RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends openssl ca-certificates && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
+WORKDIR /app
+
+FROM base AS dependencies
+COPY package.json package-lock.json ./
+COPY apps/api/package.json ./apps/api/package.json
+COPY apps/web/package.json ./apps/web/package.json
+COPY packages/contracts/package.json ./packages/contracts/package.json
+RUN npm ci --no-audit --no-fund
+
+FROM dependencies AS build
+COPY . .
+ARG API_URL=http://api:4000
+ENV API_URL=${API_URL} NEXT_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1
+RUN npm run db:generate && npm run build:runtime && npm run build --workspace apps/web
+
+# The disposable migration/seed image includes the Prisma CLI; application images do not.
+FROM build AS tools
+USER node
+CMD ["node", "scripts/bootstrap-container.mjs"]
+
+FROM build AS production-dependencies
+RUN npm prune --omit=dev --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund
+
+FROM base AS runtime
+COPY --from=production-dependencies --chown=node:node /app/node_modules ./node_modules
+COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/dist ./dist
+COPY --from=build --chown=node:node /app/package.json ./package.json
+USER node
+CMD ["node", "dist/apps/api/src/server.js"]

-# fullstack-ai-operations-console
-Full-stack AI operations console built with Next.js, TypeScript, Fastify, PostgreSQL, and Prisma. Focused on workflow execution, API integrations, human approvals, and operational visibility.
+# Full-Stack AI Operations Console
+
+An operations workspace for defining workflows, approving requests, executing an HTTP integration, and investigating failures. Next.js/React/TypeScript provide the interface; Fastify exposes the API; Prisma persists records in PostgreSQL; a separate worker owns execution.
+
+The integration is an explicit **deterministic sandbox** for support-request classification and synthetic ticket creation. There is no live LLM, customer data, or claimed business ROI. This project demonstrates the application and operational controls around a provider boundary.
+
+## Review
+
+[Evidence index](docs/EVIDENCE.md) · [Case study](docs/PORTFOLIO_CASE_STUDY.md) · [Architecture](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) · [API](docs/API.md) · [Decisions](docs/DECISIONS.md) · [Container setup and release boundary](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md) · [Limitations](docs/KNOWN_LIMITATIONS.md)
+
+## Behavior
+
+- Persisted cookie sessions, revocation/expiry, operator/viewer permissions, and owner-scoped records.
+- Workflow CRUD with optimistic versions and archival that retains history.
+- Validated execution input, owner-scoped idempotency keys, and immutable workflow snapshots.
+- Approval or rejection before outbound HTTP. Rejected runs cannot execute.
+- A standalone worker with conditional claims, expiring leases, fenced writes, bounded retries/timeouts, and manual recovery.
+- Dashboard, execution history, approval decisions, and attempt/event timelines on desktop and mobile.
+
+## PostgreSQL setup
+
+Requires Node.js 22+, npm, and PostgreSQL 16+. Create a dedicated non-production database and account. Copy `.env.example` to `.env`; configure `DATABASE_URL`, a random `SANDBOX_TOKEN` of at least 24 characters, and a unique `DEMO_PASSWORD` of at least 12 characters. Keep the file private and untracked.
+
+```bash
+npm ci
+npm run db:generate
+npm run db:migrate
+npm run db:seed
+npm run dev
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:3000`. The synthetic local accounts are `operator@example.test` and `viewer@example.test`, using your configured password. The viewer begins with no records. Default loopback ports: API 4000, sandbox 4100, worker health 4200.
+
+For the built frontend:
+
+```bash
+npm run build
+npm run start --workspace apps/web
+```
+
+Run the API, worker, and sandbox separately using their scripts. `APP_ORIGIN` must exactly match the browser origin. Production mode requires HTTPS and uses Secure cookies. `API_URL` configures the Next.js upstream rewrite **at build time**. A production host/provider is outside this sandbox release.
+
+## Restricted-container fallback
+
+PGlite runs the real PostgreSQL WASM engine through a development TCP multiplexer. It differs from native PostgreSQL concurrency and has no socket authentication, so it binds only to loopback. CI uses native PostgreSQL.
+
+```bash
+npm run setup:local
+node scripts/verify-local.mjs dev
+```
+
+The setup command creates ignored `.env` and `.env.test` with random credentials and separate local database ports. Read `DEMO_PASSWORD` privately from `.env`. It refuses to overwrite existing environments. The harness keeps services and checks in one parent network namespace.
+
+## Docker review stack
+
+Requires Docker Engine and Compose v2. This is a loopback-only local demonstration with a built standalone Next.js frontend, compiled Node.js API/worker/sandbox, native PostgreSQL, migrations and synthetic demo accounts.
+
+```bash
+node scripts/setup-containers.mjs
+docker compose --env-file .env.docker up --build --detach --wait --wait-timeout 180
+node --env-file=.env.docker scripts/container-smoke.mjs
+```
+
+Open `http://localhost:3000`. Read the password privately from ignored `.env.docker`. Only the frontend port is published, on `127.0.0.1`. Stop the demo with `docker compose --env-file .env.docker down`; this preserves its database volume. Details, browser reproduction and production prerequisites are in [DEPLOYMENT.md](docs/DEPLOYMENT.md).
+
+## Checks
+
+Integration tests **truncate the configured test database**. Use a disposable database and set `ALLOW_TEST_DB_RESET=1`. Never point tests at production. `.env.test` is loaded for unit/integration checks.
+
+```bash
+npm run typecheck
+npm run lint
+npm run format:check
+npm run test:coverage
+npm run build:runtime
+npm run build --workspace apps/web
+npm run db:seed
+npx playwright install --with-deps chromium
+npm run test:e2e
+npm run security:secrets
+npm run security:audit
+npm run evidence:check
+```
+
+For the restricted container:
+
+```bash
+node scripts/verify-local.mjs tests
+node scripts/prepare-browser.mjs
+node scripts/verify-local.mjs e2e
+```
+
+The fallback browser is real Chromium from `@sparticuz/chromium`, with installed FFmpeg for recording. E2E starts the built frontend, API, database connection, worker, and sandbox. It drives the UI without mocking API responses.
+
+The local PGlite harness marks one database constraint-error case as native-only because its bridge does not reliably relay that error protocol to Prisma. That case is explicitly skipped locally and executed in the native PostgreSQL CI suite; this distinction is reported in the evidence counts.
+
+GitHub Actions checks formatting, ESLint, strict types, native PostgreSQL integration, compiled backend and standalone frontend builds, desktop/mobile E2E, known secret patterns, and npm advisories. A separate container job builds and runs the Compose stack, executes HTTP smoke checks and runs the same browser suite against those containers. Generated CI credentials are masked before entering later step environments. Recordings/traces/reports have 14-day retention; reviewed source is packaged for approval. No workflow merges or deploys production.

+import Fastify, { FastifyRequest } from 'fastify';
+import cookie from '@fastify/cookie';
+import helmet from '@fastify/helmet';
+import rateLimit from '@fastify/rate-limit';
+import { PrismaClient, User } from '@prisma/client';
+import { z, ZodError } from 'zod';
+import {
+  workflowSchema,
+  loginSchema,
+  decisionSchema,
+  idSchema,
+  idempotencySchema,
+  runStatuses,
+} from '../../../packages/contracts/src/index.js';
+import { getConfig } from './config.js';
+import { digest, hashPassword, safeEqual, token, verifyPassword } from './auth.js';
+import { AppError, notFound } from './errors.js';
+import { admitRun, decideRun, recoverRun } from './engine.js';
+
+declare module 'fastify' {
+  interface FastifyRequest {
+    principal?: User;
+    csrfToken?: string;
+    sessionId?: string;
+  }
+}
+export async function buildApp(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  options: { logging?: boolean; rateLimit?: boolean } = {},
+) {
+  const config = getConfig();
+  const app = Fastify({
+    bodyLimit: 16384,
+    requestTimeout: 15000,
+    logger: options.logging
+      ? {
+          redact: [
+            'req.headers.cookie',
+            'req.headers.authorization',
+            'req.body',
+            'res.headers.set-cookie',
+          ],
+          level: 'info',
+        }
+      : false,
+  });
+  await app.register(cookie);
+  await app.register(helmet);
+  if (options.rateLimit !== false)
+    await app.register(rateLimit, { max: 600, timeWindow: '1 minute' });
+  const dummyHash = await hashPassword(token());
+  const user = (r: FastifyRequest) => {
+    if (!r.principal) throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Sign in required');
+    return r.principal;
+  };
+  const operator = (r: FastifyRequest) => {
+    const u = user(r);
+    if (u.role !== 'OPERATOR') throw new AppError(403, 'FORBIDDEN', 'Operator permission required');
+    return u;
+  };
+  app.addHook('onRequest', async (req, reply) => {
+    reply.header('cache-control', 'no-store');
+    const path = req.url.split('?')[0];
+    if (path === '/health' || path === '/v1/auth/login') return;
+    const raw = req.cookies.ops_session;
+    if (!raw || raw.length !== 64) throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Sign in required');
+    const session = await db.session.findUnique({
+      where: { id: digest(raw) },
+      include: { user: true },
+    });
+    if (!session || session.expiresAt <= new Date())
+      throw new AppError(401, 'UNAUTHENTICATED', 'Session expired or invalid');
+    req.principal = session.user;
+    req.csrfToken = session.csrfToken;
+    req.sessionId = session.id;
+    if (['POST', 'PATCH', 'PUT', 'DELETE'].includes(req.method)) {
+      if (req.headers.origin !== config.APP_ORIGIN)
+        throw new AppError(403, 'INVALID_ORIGIN', 'Request origin is not allowed');
+      const csrf = req.headers['x-csrf-token'];
+      if (typeof csrf !== 'string' || !safeEqual(csrf, session.csrfToken))
+        throw new AppError(403, 'INVALID_CSRF', 'CSRF token is missing or invalid');
+    }
+  });
+  app.setErrorHandler((error, req, reply) => {
+    if (error instanceof ZodError)
+      return reply.code(400).send({
+        code: 'VALIDATION_ERROR',
+        message: 'Request validation failed',
+        fields: error.issues.map((i) => ({ path: i.path.join('.'), message: i.message })),
+        requestId: req.id,
+      });
+    if (error instanceof AppError)
+      return reply
+        .code(error.statusCode)
+        .send({ code: error.code, message: error.message, requestId: req.id });
+    const status = (error as { statusCode?: number }).statusCode;
+    if (status && status < 500)
+      return reply.code(status).send({
+        code: status === 429 ? 'RATE_LIMITED' : 'BAD_REQUEST',
+        message: status === 429 ? 'Too many requests' : 'Request could not be processed',
+        requestId: req.id,
+      });
+    req.log.error({ err: error, requestId: req.id }, 'request_failed');
+    return reply
+      .code(500)
+      .send({ code: 'INTERNAL_ERROR', message: 'Request failed', requestId: req.id });
+  });
+  app.get('/health', async () => {
+    await db.$queryRaw`SELECT 1`;
+    return { status: 'ok', database: 'connected' };
+  });
+  app.post(
+    '/v1/auth/login',
+    { config: { rateLimit: { max: 8, timeWindow: '1 minute' } } },
+    async (req, reply) => {
+      if (req.headers.origin !== config.APP_ORIGIN)
+        throw new AppError(403, 'INVALID_ORIGIN', 'Request origin is not allowed');
+      const data = loginSchema.parse(req.body);
+      const found = await db.user.findUnique({ where: { email: data.email } });
+      const valid = await verifyPassword(data.password, found?.passwordHash ?? dummyHash);
+      if (!found || !valid)
+        throw new AppError(401, 'INVALID_CREDENTIALS', 'Email or password is incorrect');
+      const raw = token(),
+        csrfToken = token(),
+        expiresAt = new Date(Date.now() + 8 * 60 * 60 * 1000);
+      await db.session.create({
+        data: { id: digest(raw), userId: found.id, csrfToken, expiresAt },
+      });
+      reply.setCookie('ops_session', raw, {
+        httpOnly: true,
+        secure: config.NODE_ENV === 'production',
+        sameSite: 'strict',
+        path: '/',
+        maxAge: 8 * 60 * 60,
+      });
+      return { user: { id: found.id, email: found.email, role: found.role }, csrfToken };
+    },
+  );
+  app.get('/v1/auth/me', async (req) => {
+    const u = user(req);
+    return { user: { id: u.id, email: u.email, role: u.role }, csrfToken: req.csrfToken };
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/auth/logout', async (req, reply) => {
+    await db.session.deleteMany({ where: { id: req.sessionId } });
+    reply.clearCookie('ops_session', { path: '/' });
+    return { ok: true };
+  });
+  app.get('/v1/workflows', async (req) => ({
+    items: await db.workflow.findMany({
+      where: { ownerId: user(req).id, archived: false },
+      orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' },
+      take: 100,
+    }),
+  }));
+  app.post('/v1/workflows', async (req, reply) => {
+    const data = workflowSchema.parse(req.body);
+    reply.code(201);
+    return db.workflow.create({ data: { ...data, ownerId: operator(req).id } });
+  });
+  app.patch('/v1/workflows/:id', async (req) => {
+    const id = idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id),
+      ownerId = operator(req).id;
+    const { version, ...data } = workflowSchema
+      .extend({ version: z.number().int().positive() })
+      .parse(req.body);
+    const result = await db.workflow.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, version, archived: false },
+      data: { ...data, version: { increment: 1 } },
+    });
+    if (!result.count) {
+      const found = await db.workflow.findFirst({ where: { id, ownerId, archived: false } });
+      if (!found) throw notFound();
+      throw new AppError(409, 'VERSION_CONFLICT', 'Workflow changed; reload before saving');
+    }
+    return db.workflow.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+  });
+  app.delete('/v1/workflows/:id', async (req) => {
+    const id = idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id),
+      ownerId = operator(req).id;
+    const result = await db.workflow.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, archived: false },
+      data: { archived: true },
+    });
+    if (!result.count) throw notFound();
+    return { ok: true };
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/workflows/:id/runs', async (req, reply) => {
+    const ownerId = operator(req).id,
+      id = idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id),
+      key = idempotencySchema.parse(req.headers['idempotency-key']);
+    const result = await admitRun(db, ownerId, id, key, req.body);
+    reply.code(result.replayed ? 200 : 201);
+    return result;
+  });
+  app.get('/v1/runs', async (req) => {
+    const query = z
+      .object({
+        status: z.enum(runStatuses).optional(),
+        cursor: z.uuid().optional(),
+        limit: z.coerce.number().int().min(1).max(50).default(30),
+      })
+      .strict()
+      .parse(req.query);
+    const items = await db.run.findMany({
+      where: { ownerId: user(req).id, ...(query.status ? { status: query.status } : {}) },
+      orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'desc' }, { id: 'desc' }],
+      take: query.limit + 1,
+      ...(query.cursor ? { cursor: { id: query.cursor }, skip: 1 } : {}),
+    });
+    const more = items.length > query.limit;
+    if (more) items.pop();
+    return { items, nextCursor: more ? items.at(-1)?.id : null };
+  });
+  app.get('/v1/runs/:id', async (req) => {
+    const run = await db.run.findFirst({
+      where: { id: idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id), ownerId: user(req).id },
+      include: {
+        attempts: { orderBy: { number: 'asc' } },
+        events: { orderBy: [{ createdAt: 'asc' }, { id: 'asc' }] },
+      },
+    });
+    if (!run) throw notFound();
+    return run;
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/runs/:id/decision', async (req) => {
+    const ownerId = operator(req).id;
+    const { decision } = decisionSchema.parse(req.body);
+    return decideRun(db, ownerId, idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id), decision);
+  });
+  app.post('/v1/runs/:id/retry', async (req) =>
+    recoverRun(db, operator(req).id, idSchema.parse((req.params as { id: string }).id)),
+  );
+  app.get('/v1/dashboard', async (req) => {
+    const ownerId = user(req).id;
+    const [grouped, workflowCount, recent] = await Promise.all([
+      db.run.groupBy({ by: ['status'], where: { ownerId }, _count: { _all: true } }),
+      db.workflow.count({ where: { ownerId, archived: false } }),
+      db.run.findMany({ where: { ownerId }, orderBy: { createdAt: 'desc' }, take: 6 }),
+    ]);
+    const counts = Object.fromEntries(
+      runStatuses.map((s) => [s, grouped.find((g) => g.status === s)?._count._all ?? 0]),
+    );
+    return { workflowCount, counts, recent };
+  });
+  return app;
+}

+import { createHash, randomBytes, scrypt as scryptCallback, timingSafeEqual } from 'node:crypto';
+import { promisify } from 'node:util';
+const scrypt = promisify(scryptCallback);
+export async function hashPassword(password: string) {
+  const salt = randomBytes(16).toString('hex');
+  const hash = (await scrypt(password, salt, 64)) as Buffer;
+  return `scrypt:${salt}:${hash.toString('hex')}`;
+}
+export async function verifyPassword(password: string, encoded: string) {
+  const [scheme, salt, value] = encoded.split(':');
+  if (scheme !== 'scrypt' || !salt || !value || value.length !== 128) return false;
+  const candidate = (await scrypt(password, salt, 64)) as Buffer;
+  const expected = Buffer.from(value, 'hex');
+  return candidate.length === expected.length && timingSafeEqual(candidate, expected);
+}
+export const digest = (value: string) => createHash('sha256').update(value).digest('hex');
+export const token = () => randomBytes(32).toString('hex');
+export function safeEqual(a: string, b: string) {
+  const x = Buffer.from(a),
+    y = Buffer.from(b);
+  return x.length === y.length && timingSafeEqual(x, y);
+}

+import { z } from 'zod';
+export function getConfig() {
+  const c = z
+    .object({
+      DATABASE_URL: z.string().startsWith('postgresql://'),
+      APP_ORIGIN: z.url().default('http://localhost:3000'),
+      SANDBOX_URL: z.url().default('http://127.0.0.1:4100'),
+      SANDBOX_TOKEN: z.string().min(24),
+      NODE_ENV: z.enum(['development', 'test', 'production']).default('development'),
+    })
+    .parse(process.env);
+  const origin = new URL(c.APP_ORIGIN);
+  if (c.APP_ORIGIN !== origin.origin)
+    throw new Error('APP_ORIGIN must be an origin without a path');
+  if (c.NODE_ENV === 'production' && origin.protocol !== 'https:')
+    throw new Error('Production requires HTTPS APP_ORIGIN');
+  const sandbox = new URL(c.SANDBOX_URL);
+  if (
+    !['http:', 'https:'].includes(sandbox.protocol) ||
+    sandbox.username ||
+    sandbox.password ||
+    sandbox.search ||
+    sandbox.hash
+  )
+    throw new Error('Invalid configured integration URL');
+  return c;
+}

+import { Prisma, PrismaClient, Run } from '@prisma/client';
+import { randomUUID } from 'node:crypto';
+import {
+  workflowSchema,
+  executionSchema,
+  sandboxResultSchema,
+} from '../../../packages/contracts/src/index.js';
+import { AppError, notFound } from './errors.js';
+import { digest } from './auth.js';
+
+const json = (v: unknown) => v as Prisma.InputJsonValue;
+export const snapshot = (run: Run) => {
+  const { version, ...data } = run.workflowSnapshot as Record<string, unknown>;
+  return workflowSchema.parse(data);
+};
+export async function admitRun(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  ownerId: string,
+  workflowId: string,
+  key: string,
+  payload: unknown,
+) {
+  const input = executionSchema.parse(payload);
+  const requestHash = digest(JSON.stringify({ workflowId, input }));
+  const existing = await db.run.findUnique({
+    where: { ownerId_idempotencyKey: { ownerId, idempotencyKey: key } },
+  });
+  if (existing) {
+    if (existing.requestHash !== requestHash)
+      throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', 'This key was used for different input');
+    return { run: existing, replayed: true };
+  }
+  const workflow = await db.workflow.findFirst({
+    where: { id: workflowId, ownerId, archived: false },
+  });
+  if (!workflow) throw notFound();
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const id = randomUUID();
+    const created = await tx.run.createMany({
+      skipDuplicates: true,
+      data: {
+        id,
+        ownerId,
+        workflowId,
+        idempotencyKey: key,
+        requestHash,
+        input: json(input),
+        workflowSnapshot: json({
+          ...workflowSchema.parse({
+            name: workflow.name,
+            description: workflow.description,
+            requiresApproval: workflow.requiresApproval,
+            maxAttempts: workflow.maxAttempts,
+            timeoutMs: workflow.timeoutMs,
+            sandboxMode: workflow.sandboxMode,
+          }),
+          version: workflow.version,
+        }),
+        status: workflow.requiresApproval ? 'WAITING_APPROVAL' : 'QUEUED',
+      },
+    });
+    const run = await tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({
+      where: { ownerId_idempotencyKey: { ownerId, idempotencyKey: key } },
+    });
+    if (run.requestHash !== requestHash)
+      throw new AppError(409, 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT', 'This key was used for different input');
+    if (created.count)
+      await tx.runEvent.create({
+        data: {
+          runId: id,
+          type: workflow.requiresApproval ? 'APPROVAL_REQUESTED' : 'RUN_ADMITTED',
+          actorId: ownerId,
+          detail: { workflowVersion: workflow.version },
+        },
+      });
+    return { run, replayed: created.count === 0 };
+  });
+}
+export async function decideRun(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  ownerId: string,
+  id: string,
+  decision: 'approve' | 'reject',
+) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const run = await tx.run.findFirst({ where: { id, ownerId } });
+    if (!run) throw notFound();
+    const changed = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, status: 'WAITING_APPROVAL' },
+      data: {
+        status: decision === 'approve' ? 'QUEUED' : 'REJECTED',
+        approvedBy: ownerId,
+        decidedAt: new Date(),
+        completedAt: decision === 'reject' ? new Date() : null,
+      },
+    });
+    if (!changed.count)
+      throw new AppError(409, 'STATE_CONFLICT', 'Approval has already been decided');
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: {
+        runId: id,
+        actorId: ownerId,
+        type: decision === 'approve' ? 'APPROVED' : 'REJECTED',
+        detail: {},
+      },
+    });
+    return tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+  });
+}
+export async function recoverRun(db: PrismaClient, ownerId: string, id: string) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const run = await tx.run.findFirst({ where: { id, ownerId } });
+    if (!run) throw notFound();
+    const changed = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id, ownerId, status: 'FAILED', recoveryCount: { lt: 3 } },
+      data: {
+        status: 'QUEUED',
+        cycleAttempts: 0,
+        recoveryCount: { increment: 1 },
+        errorCode: null,
+        errorMessage: null,
+        completedAt: null,
+        availableAt: new Date(),
+      },
+    });
+    if (!changed.count)
+      throw new AppError(
+        409,
+        'STATE_CONFLICT',
+        'Only failed runs with fewer than 3 recoveries can be retried',
+      );
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: {
+        runId: id,
+        actorId: ownerId,
+        type: 'RECOVERY_REQUESTED',
+        detail: { recovery: run.recoveryCount + 1 },
+      },
+    });
+    return tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id } });
+  });
+}
+export async function claimRun(db: PrismaClient, now = new Date()) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const run = await tx.run.findFirst({
+      where: { status: 'QUEUED', availableAt: { lte: now } },
+      orderBy: { createdAt: 'asc' },
+    });
+    if (!run) return null;
+    const config = snapshot(run),
+      leaseToken = randomUUID();
+    const result = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id: run.id, status: 'QUEUED' },
+      data: {
+        status: 'RUNNING',
+        attemptCount: { increment: 1 },
+        cycleAttempts: { increment: 1 },
+        leaseToken,
+        leaseUntil: new Date(now.getTime() + config.timeoutMs + 5000),
+      },
+    });
+    if (!result.count) return null;
+    await tx.attempt.create({ data: { runId: run.id, number: run.attemptCount + 1 } });
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: { runId: run.id, type: 'ATTEMPT_STARTED', detail: { attempt: run.attemptCount + 1 } },
+    });
+    return tx.run.findUniqueOrThrow({ where: { id: run.id } });
+  });
+}
+export type Outcome =
+  | { ok: true; output: Prisma.InputJsonValue }
+  | { ok: false; code: string; message: string; retryable: boolean };
+export async function settleRun(
+  db: PrismaClient,
+  run: Run,
+  outcome: Outcome,
+  now = new Date(),
+  retryDelayMs = 250,
+) {
+  return db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+    const config = snapshot(run);
+    const retry = !outcome.ok && outcome.retryable && run.cycleAttempts < config.maxAttempts;
+    const status = outcome.ok ? 'SUCCEEDED' : retry ? 'QUEUED' : 'FAILED';
+    const changed = await tx.run.updateMany({
+      where: { id: run.id, status: 'RUNNING', leaseToken: run.leaseToken, leaseUntil: { gt: now } },
+      data: {
+        status,
+        leaseToken: null,
+        leaseUntil: null,
+        ...(outcome.ok
+          ? { output: outcome.output, errorCode: null, errorMessage: null }
+          : { errorCode: outcome.code, errorMessage: outcome.message }),
+        availableAt: new Date(
+          now.getTime() + retryDelayMs * Math.pow(2, Math.max(0, run.cycleAttempts - 1)),
+        ),
+        completedAt: status === 'QUEUED' ? null : now,
+      },
+    });
+    if (!changed.count) return false; // Lease fencing: expired/stale workers cannot commit.
+    await tx.attempt.update({
+      where: { runId_number: { runId: run.id, number: run.attemptCount } },
+      data: {
+        status: outcome.ok ? 'SUCCEEDED' : outcome.code === 'TIMEOUT' ? 'TIMED_OUT' : 'FAILED',
+        errorCode: outcome.ok ? null : outcome.code,
+        finishedAt: now,
+      },
+    });
+    await tx.runEvent.create({
+      data: {
+        runId: run.id,
+        type: outcome.ok ? 'RUN_SUCCEEDED' : retry ? 'RETRY_SCHEDULED' : 'RUN_FAILED',
+        detail: outcome.ok
+          ? { attempt: run.attemptCount }
+          : { attempt: run.attemptCount, code: outcome.code },
+      },
+    });
+    return true;
+  });
+}
+export async function reapExpired(db: PrismaClient, now = new Date()) {
+  const expired = await db.run.findMany({
+    where: { status: 'RUNNING', leaseUntil: { lte: now } },
+    take: 50,
+  });
+  let recovered = 0;
+  for (const run of expired) {
+    const done = await db.$transaction(async (tx) => {
+      const exhausted = run.cycleAttempts >= snapshot(run).maxAttempts;
+      const result = await tx.run.updateMany({
+        where: {
+          id: run.id,
+          status: 'RUNNING',
+          leaseToken: run.leaseToken,
+          leaseUntil: { lte: now },
+        },
+        data: {
+          status: exhausted ? 'FAILED' : 'QUEUED',
+          leaseToken: null,
+          leaseUntil: null,
+          availableAt: now,
+          errorCode: 'WORKER_LOST',
+          errorMessage: 'Worker lease expired; execution ownership was recovered',
+          completedAt: exhausted ? now : null,
+        },
+      });
+      if (!result.count) return 0;
+      await tx.attempt.update({
+        where: { runId_number: { runId: run.id, number: run.attemptCount } },
+        data: { status: 'WORKER_LOST', errorCode: 'WORKER_LOST', finishedAt: now },
+      });
+      await tx.runEvent.create({
+        data: {
+          runId: run.id,
+          type: 'LEASE_EXPIRED',
+          detail: { attempt: run.attemptCount, exhausted },
+        },
+      });
+      return 1;
+    });
+    recovered += done;
+  }
+  return recovered;
+}
+export async function executeSandbox(
+  run: Run,
+  url: string,
+  integrationToken: string,
+): Promise<Outcome> {
+  const config = snapshot(run);
+  const controller = new AbortController();
+  const timer = setTimeout(() => controller.abort(), config.timeoutMs);
+  try {
+    // The integration URL is server-configured. Workflow input cannot select arbitrary hosts.
+    const response = await fetch(`${url.replace(/\/$/, '')}/tickets`, {
+      method: 'POST',
+      redirect: 'error',
+      signal: controller.signal,
+      headers: {
+        'content-type': 'application/json',
+        authorization: `Bearer ${integrationToken}`,
+        'idempotency-key': run.id,
+        'x-attempt': String(run.attemptCount),
+      },
+      body: JSON.stringify({
+        input: run.input,
+        mode: config.sandboxMode,
+        maxAttempts: config.maxAttempts,
+      }),
+    });
+    if (!response.ok)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: response.status >= 500 ? 'UPSTREAM_UNAVAILABLE' : 'UPSTREAM_REJECTED',
+        message: `Sandbox returned HTTP ${response.status}`,
+        retryable: response.status >= 500 || response.status === 429,
+      };
+    // Bound the body before JSON parsing, including chunked responses.
+    const reader = response.body?.getReader();
+    if (!reader) throw new Error('Empty body');
+    let size = 0;
+    const chunks: Uint8Array[] = [];
+    while (true) {
+      const { done, value } = await reader.read();
+      if (done) break;
+      size += value.length;
+      if (size > 16384) {
+        await reader.cancel();
+        return {
+          ok: false,
+          code: 'INVALID_RESPONSE',
+          message: 'Sandbox response exceeded 16 KiB',
+          retryable: false,
+        };
+      }
+      chunks.push(value);
+    }
+    const result = sandboxResultSchema.safeParse(
+      JSON.parse(Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8')),
+    );
+    if (!result.success)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: 'INVALID_RESPONSE',
+        message: 'Sandbox returned an invalid response',
+        retryable: false,
+      };
+    return { ok: true, output: json(result.data) };
+  } catch (error) {
+    if (controller.signal.aborted)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: 'TIMEOUT',
+        message: `Sandbox exceeded ${config.timeoutMs} ms timeout`,
+        retryable: true,
+      };
+    if (error instanceof SyntaxError)
+      return {
+        ok: false,
+        code: 'INVALID_RESPONSE',
+        message: 'Sandbox returned invalid JSON',
+        retryable: false,
+      };
+    return {
+      ok: false,
+      code: 'NETWORK_ERROR',
+      message: 'Sandbox connection failed',
+      retryable: true,
+    };
+  } finally {
+    clearTimeout(timer);
+  }
+}
+export async function workerTick(db: PrismaClient, url: string, integrationToken: string) {
+  await reapExpired(db);
+  const run = await claimRun(db);
+  if (!run) return null;
+  const result = await executeSandbox(run, url, integrationToken);
+  await settleRun(db, run, result);
+  return run.id;
+}

+import Fastify from 'fastify';
+import { z } from 'zod';
+import { digest, safeEqual } from './auth.js';
+import { executionSchema, workflowSchema } from '../../../packages/contracts/src/index.js';
+export function classify(message: string) {
+  const m = message.toLowerCase();
+  return {
+    category: /bill|invoice|payment|refund/.test(m)
+      ? ('billing' as const)
+      : /error|broken|api|integration/.test(m)
+        ? ('technical' as const)
+        : ('general' as const),
+    priority: /urgent|outage|blocked/.test(m) ? ('urgent' as const) : ('normal' as const),
+    summary: message.trim().slice(0, 160),
+    provider: 'deterministic-sandbox' as const,
+  };
+}
+export async function buildSandbox(integrationToken: string) {
+  const app = Fastify({ bodyLimit: 8192, logger: false });
+  const cache = new Map<string, { hash: string; result: unknown }>();
+  const pending = new Map<string, { hash: string; promise: Promise<unknown> }>(),
+    requestCounts = new Map<string, number>(),
+    creationCounts = new Map<string, number>();
+  let requests = 0;
+  app.get('/health', async () => ({ status: 'ok', provider: 'deterministic-sandbox' }));
+  app.post('/tickets', async (req, reply) => {
+    if (!safeEqual(String(req.headers.authorization ?? ''), `Bearer ${integrationToken}`))
+      return reply.code(401).send({ code: 'UNAUTHORIZED' });
+    const schema = z
+      .object({
+        input: executionSchema,
+        mode: workflowSchema.shape.sandboxMode,
+        maxAttempts: z.number().int().min(1).max(5),
+      })
+      .strict();
+    const data = schema.safeParse(req.body);
+    const key = z.uuid().safeParse(req.headers['idempotency-key']);
+    const attempt = z.coerce.number().int().min(1).safeParse(req.headers['x-attempt']);
+    if (!data.success || !key.success || !attempt.success)
+      return reply.code(400).send({ code: 'INVALID_INPUT' });
+    requests++;
+    requestCounts.set(key.data, (requestCounts.get(key.data) ?? 0) + 1);
+    const hash = digest(JSON.stringify(data.data.input)),
+      previous = cache.get(key.data);
+    if (previous) {
+      if (previous.hash !== hash) return reply.code(409).send({ code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' });
+      return previous.result;
+    }
+    const inFlight = pending.get(key.data);
+    if (inFlight) {
+      if (inFlight.hash !== hash) return reply.code(409).send({ code: 'IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT' });
+      return inFlight.promise;
+    }
+    const { mode, maxAttempts, input } = data.data;
+    if (mode === 'failure') return reply.code(422).send({ code: 'REJECTED' });
+    if (
+      (mode === 'flaky' && attempt.data === 1) ||
+      (mode === 'recoverable' && attempt.data <= maxAttempts)
+    )
+      return reply.code(503).send({ code: 'TEMPORARILY_UNAVAILABLE' });
+    const promise = (async () => {
+      if (mode === 'timeout') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 12000));
+      if (mode === 'slow') await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 1500));
+      const result = { ticketId: `sbx_${key.data.slice(0, 12)}`, ...classify(input.message) };
+      cache.set(key.data, { hash, result });
+      creationCounts.set(key.data, (creationCounts.get(key.data) ?? 0) + 1);
+      return result;
+    })();
+    pending.set(key.data, { hash, promise });
+    try {
+      return await promise;
+    } finally {
+      pending.delete(key.data);
+    }
+  });
+  return {
+    app,
+    stats: (id?: string) => ({
+      requests: id ? (requestCounts.get(id) ?? 0) : requests,
+      tickets: id ? (creationCounts.get(id) ?? 0) : cache.size,
+    }),
+  };
+}

+import { PrismaClient } from '@prisma/client';
+import { getConfig } from './config.js';
+import { workerTick } from './engine.js';
+import { createServer } from 'node:http';
+const config = getConfig(),
+  db = new PrismaClient();
+let stopping = false;
+await db.$connect();
+let healthy = true;
+const health = createServer((req, res) => {
+  res.writeHead(req.url === '/health' ? (healthy ? 200 : 503) : 404, {
+    'content-type': 'application/json',
+  });
+  res.end(JSON.stringify({ status: healthy ? 'ok' : 'degraded', worker: 'standalone' }));
+});
+health.listen(Number(process.env.WORKER_PORT ?? 4200), '127.0.0.1');
+for (const signal of ['SIGINT', 'SIGTERM'] as const)
+  process.on(signal, () => {
+    stopping = true;
+  });
+while (!stopping) {
+  try {
+    const id = await workerTick(db, config.SANDBOX_URL, config.SANDBOX_TOKEN);
+    healthy = true;
+    if (id) process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify({ event: 'worker_tick', runId: id }) + '\n');
+  } catch (error) {
+    healthy = false;
+    const e = error as { name?: string; code?: string };
+    process.stderr.write(
+      JSON.stringify({ event: 'worker_tick_failed', errorType: e.name, errorCode: e.code }) + '\n',
+    );
+  }
+  await new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 250));
+}
+await db.$disconnect();
+health.close();
